config.scope: Retrospective development audit over original train and validation recordings only. Previously inspected data and informed model family choices; not a fresh holdout or a future-time/unseen-machine benchmark.
config.splitter: GroupKFold with shuffle=True, random_state=42; whole overlap groups, not individual readings. Same seed for every inner split.
config.selection: Select hyperparameters, threshold and persistence on pooled inner out-of-fold predictions only. Among recall-feasible points maximize precision, then minimize false-onset frequency, then maximize recall. Keep the first candidate on an exact tie.
config.infeasible_fallback: If no point satisfies all recall floors, maximize the minimum capped ratio of achieved recall to each required recall floor, then precision, then minimize false-onset frequency, then recall. Disclose infeasibility. Do not change constraints or discard the outer fold.
config.final_refit: After nested assessment, select a candidate and alert settings using five-fold grouped out-of-fold scores across the full development pool, then refit on the pool. Save an audit artifact; do not activate it. Its selection scores are not independent performance.
config.reporting: Pooled confusion counts, precision/recall, available-normal FPR/exposure, false onsets, event recall/delay, macro group precision, fold ranges, matched per-group deltas, inner feasibility and training-versus-outer gaps. No point adjustment. No new access to old test CSVs.
